decisions.reason: As a chemicals firm, we have little related knowledge or absorptive capacity in branded vegan superfood drinks, so early market learning is harder to use and the product is unlikely to justify continued commitment.
Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions build closely on chemical-process and industrial systems knowledge, so we can absorb feedback and improve the offer with capabilities near our core.
A waste-oil-to-energy plant fits strongly with process-engineering and conversion know-how, and its dedicated webpage suggests enough strategic emphasis to continue refining rather than withdraw it.
Plastic-waste-to-fuel technology is adjacent to our chemical and thermal conversion expertise, giving us a reasonable base to learn from early results and develop the product further.
